sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 第一步：假设结论不成立。
另一方面，由数列的单调性，0≤xᵢ≤u<1 (k<i≤n)。
对任意 1≤i≤k，由于 0≤xᵢ<1，且 m≥2，有 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²。

对 i=1,2,…,k 求和，得到
∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m ≤ ∑_{i=1}^k (xᵢ−u+uxᵢ) = t−ku+ut。
对任意 k<i≤n，由于 0≤xᵢ≤u<1，m≥2，有 xᵢ^(m−1)≤xᵢ≤u。
两边乘以非负数 xᵢ，得 xᵢ^m≤uxᵢ。
当 n=k 时，上述两边均视为零，结论仍成立。

将前后两部分相加：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。

statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n), (∀ i j : Fin n, i ≤ j → x j ≤ x i) → (∀ i : Fin n, 0 ≤ x i) → (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m) ≥ 1 → (∑ i : Fin n, x i) ≤ (k : ℝ) → (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ≥ 1

  by_contra hcon
  have hprefix_lt : (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) < 1 := not_le.mp hcon
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => if h : j < n then x ⟨j, h⟩ else 0
  have hf_nonneg : ∀ j, j < n → 0 ≤ f j := by
    intro j hj
    dsimp [f]
    rw [dif_pos hj]
    exact hnonneg ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hf_total : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, x i) = ∑ i : Fin n, f (i : ℕ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        simp [f, i.isLt]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i := by
        exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => f j) n
  have hf_prefix : (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) = ∑ i : Fin k, f (i : ℕ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hik : (i : ℕ) < n := lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hkn
        simp [f, hik, Fin.castLE]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i := by
        exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => f j) k
  have hf_total_pow : (∑ i : Fin n, (x i)^m) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, (x i)^m) = ∑ i : Fin n, (f (i : ℕ))^m := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        simp [f, i.isLt]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m := by
        exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => (f j)^m) n
  let t : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i
  let u : ℝ := f (k - 1)
  have source_step_0 : ¬ ((∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ≥ 1) := hcon
  have source_step_1 : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    rw [← hf_prefix]
    exact hprefix_lt
  have hk1_lt_k : k - 1 < k := by omega
  have hk1_lt_n : k - 1 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hk1_lt_k hkn
  have hprefix_props : ∀ i, i < k → u ≤ f i ∧ f i ≤ t := by
    intro i hi
    have hin : i < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hi hkn
    have hik : i ≤ k - 1 := by omega
    have hle_fin : (⟨i, hin⟩ : Fin n) ≤ ⟨k - 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ := by
      change i ≤ k - 1
      exact hik
    have hmono_i := hmono ⟨i, hin⟩ ⟨k - 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ hle_fin
    have hu_le_fi : u ≤ f i := by
      dsimp [u, f]
      rw [dif_pos hk1_lt_n, dif_pos hin]
      exact hmono_i
    have hfi_le_t : f i ≤ t := by
      dsimp [t]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j hj => hf_nonneg j (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hj) hkn))
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
    exact ⟨hu_le_fi, hfi_le_t⟩
  have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact hf_nonneg (k - 1) hk1_lt_n
  have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := (hprefix_props (k - 1) hk1_lt_k).2
  have hu_lt_one : u < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu_le_t source_step_1
  have source_step_2 :
      0 ≤ u ∧ u < 1 ∧ t < 1 ∧ (∀ i, i < k → u ≤ f i ∧ f i ≤ t) :=
    ⟨hu_nonneg, hu_lt_one, source_step_1, hprefix_props⟩
  have source_step_3 : ∀ i, k ≤ i → i < n → 0 ≤ f i ∧ f i ≤ u ∧ u < 1 := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hk1i : k - 1 ≤ i := by omega
    have hle_fin : (⟨k - 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ : Fin n) ≤ ⟨i, hin⟩ := by
      change k - 1 ≤ i
      exact hk1i
    have hmono_i := hmono ⟨k - 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ ⟨i, hin⟩ hle_fin
    have hfi_le_u : f i ≤ u := by
      dsimp [u, f]
      rw [dif_pos hin, dif_pos hk1_lt_n]
      exact hmono_i
    exact ⟨hf_nonneg i hin, hfi_le_u, hu_lt_one⟩
  have source_step_4 : ∀ i, i < k → (f i)^m ≤ (f i)^2 := by
    intro i hi
    have hin : i < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hi hkn
    have hfi_nonneg : 0 ≤ f i := hf_nonneg i hin
    have hfi_le_t : f i ≤ t := (hprefix_props i hi).2
    have hfi_lt_one : f i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hfi_le_t source_step_1
    exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hfi_nonneg (le_of_lt hfi_lt_one) hm
  have source_step_5 : ∀ i, i < k → 0 ≤ (f i - u) * (1 - f i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hu_le : u ≤ f i := (hprefix_props i hi).1
    have hfi_le_t : f i ≤ t := (hprefix_props i hi).2
    have hfi_lt_one : f i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hfi_le_t source_step_1
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hu_le) (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hfi_lt_one))
  have source_step_6 : ∀ i, i < k → (f i)^2 ≤ f i - u + u * f i := by
    intro i hi
    have h := source_step_5 i hi
    nlinarith
  have source_step_7 : ∀ i, i < k → (f i)^m ≤ f i - u + u * f i := by
    intro i hi
    exact le_trans (source_step_4 i hi) (source_step_6 i hi)
  have source_step_8 :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (f i)^m) ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
    have hsum_le : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (f i)^m)
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (f i - u + u * f i) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => source_step_7 i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (f i)^m)
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (f i - u + u * f i) := hsum_le
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
        dsimp [t]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
  have source_step_9 : ∀ i, k ≤ i → i < n → (f i)^(m - 1) ≤ f i := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hnonneg_i : 0 ≤ f i := hf_nonneg i hin
    have hfi_le_u : f i ≤ u := (source_step_3 i hki hin).2.1
    have hfi_le_one : f i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hfi_le_u hu_lt_one)
    have hm1 : 1 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
    have h := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hnonneg_i hfi_le_one hm1
    simpa using h
  have source_step_10 : ∀ i, k ≤ i → i < n → (f i)^m ≤ u * f i := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hnonneg_i : 0 ≤ f i := hf_nonneg i hin
    have hbase : (f i)^(m - 1) ≤ u :=
      le_trans (source_step_9 i hki hin) ((source_step_3 i hki hin).2.1)
    have hmul : (f i)^m = (f i)^(m - 1) * f i := by
      have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by omega
      calc
        (f i)^m = (f i)^((m - 1) + 1) := by
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm1]
        _ = (f i)^(m - 1) * f i := by
          rw [pow_succ]
    rw [hmul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbase hnonneg_i
  have source_step_11 :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (f i)^m) ≤ u * ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, f i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi =>
      source_step_10 i (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1 (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2)
  have source_step_12 : n = k →
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (f i)^m) = 0 ∧
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, f i) = 0 := by
    intro hnk
    rw [hnk]
    simp
  have hsplit_range : ∀ g : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g i)
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, g i) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, g i := by
    intro g
    exact (Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico g hkn).symm
  have source_step_13 :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m)
        ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) := by
    have hsplit_m := hsplit_range (fun i => (f i)^m)
    have hsplit_f := hsplit_range (fun i => f i)
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m)
          = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (f i)^m)
              + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (f i)^m := hsplit_m
      _ ≤ (t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t)
              + u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, f i) := by
            exact add_le_add source_step_8 source_step_11
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) := by
            rw [hsplit_f]
            dsimp [t]
            ring
  have hTotal_le : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    simpa [hf_total] using hsum
  have source_step_14 :
      u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) ≤ u * (k : ℝ) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTotal_le source_step_2.1
  have hpow_bound : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m) ≤ t := by
    have h1 := source_step_13
    have h2 : t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i)
        ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (k : ℝ) := by
      linarith [source_step_14]
    have h3 : t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (k : ℝ) = t := by ring
    exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h2 (le_of_eq h3))
  have source_step_15 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m) < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt hpow_bound source_step_1
  have hpow_range_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i)^m := by
    have h := hpow
    rw [hf_total_pow] at h
    exact h
  have source_step_16 : False := by
    linarith [source_step_15, hpow_range_ge]
  have source_step_17 : (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ≥ 1 :=
    False.elim source_step_16
  exact source_step_16

代入上式：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≤t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤t−ku+uk=t<1。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。

【待验证题目｜本聊天上一条助理给出的证明，未改写推理，不将其身份当作官方参考答案】
设 m,n,k 均为正整数，满足 m≥2，n≥k≥2。已知非负实数 x₁≥x₂≥⋯≥xₙ≥0 满足 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 及 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k。求证 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。

【原证明】
第一步：假设结论不成立。
假设 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ<1。记 t=∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ，u=xₖ。
由条件可知 0≤u≤xᵢ≤t<1 (1≤i≤k)。
另一方面，由数列的单调性，0≤xᵢ≤u<1 (k<i≤n)。

第二步：估计前 k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 1≤i≤k，由于 0≤xᵢ<1，且 m≥2，有 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²。
又因为 u≤xᵢ<1，所以 (xᵢ−u)(1−xᵢ)≥0。
展开并整理，得 xᵢ²≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
因此 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
对 i=1,2,…,k 求和，得到
∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m ≤ ∑_{i=1}^k (xᵢ−u+uxᵢ) = t−ku+ut。

第三步：估计后 n−k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 k<i≤n，由于 0≤xᵢ≤u<1，m≥2，有 xᵢ^(m−1)≤xᵢ≤u。
两边乘以非负数 xᵢ，得 xᵢ^m≤uxᵢ。
故 ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m ≤ u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ。
当 n=k 时，上述两边均视为零，结论仍成立。

第四步：合并两个估计。
将前后两部分相加：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。

第五步：利用已知条件推出矛盾。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
代入上式：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≤t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤t−ku+uk=t<1。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。
